text:
Assistant A is better. Both correctly say the White House is in Washington, D.C., and that it isn't part of the scene described. Assistant A adds accurate, useful detail: it describes the building as a white neoclassical mansion, gives its address (1600 Pennsylvania Avenue NW), and notes it has housed every president since John Adams in 1800. Assistant B is correct but offers only the bare location. Neither engages with the puzzle's whimsical framing, so Assistant A's extra accurate context gives it the edge.

[[A]]
